packageRules.description: Django 6.x dropped support for Python <3.12 (Django only supports 3.12+ as of 6.0). requirements.txt pins django>=4.2.0,<5.0.0 for python_version<3.12 specifically so CI on 3.9-3.11 keeps working; restrict that pin to Django 4.x so Renovate doesn't repeat the breaking django>=6.1 bump for those interpreters (see PR #198 and #200).
